name: AC Repair
short_description: Fast diagnosis and repair of all air conditioning systems.
long_description: Our certified technicians diagnose and repair all types of air conditioning systems. Services include refrigerant checks and recharging, electrical component repair, capacitor and contactor replacement, compressor diagnostics, and thermostat calibration.
pricing_notes: Diagnostic fee starts at $89. Final cost depends on parts and labor. Upfront pricing provided before work begins.
ideal_for: Homeowners with an AC unit that is not cooling, blowing warm air, or not turning on.
benefits: Upfront pricing before any work begins

name: Heater & Furnace Repair
short_description: Repair and tune-up for furnaces, heat pumps, and central heating systems.
long_description: We repair gas furnaces, electric furnaces, heat pumps, and boilers. Services include igniter and flame sensor replacement, heat exchanger inspection, blower motor repair, gas valve diagnostics, and safety shutoff testing.
pricing_notes: Diagnostic fee starts at $99. Parts and labor quoted before work begins.
ideal_for: Homeowners whose heater or furnace is not turning on, not producing heat, or cycling on and off.
benefits: Full safety inspection included with every repair

name: System Installation
short_description: Full installation of new HVAC systems with free in-home estimates.
long_description: We design and install central air conditioning systems, heat pumps, ductless mini-splits, and smart thermostats. Every installation includes load calculations, proper sizing, and a full system test. Financing available.
pricing_notes: Installation starts around $3,500 depending on system size and home requirements. Free in-home estimates available.
ideal_for: Homeowners replacing an aging system, building a new home, or upgrading to a more efficient unit.
benefits: Free in-home estimate with Manual J load calculation
Energy-efficient system options across all budgets
Permits pulled and city inspections handled

name: Seasonal Maintenance
short_description: Annual tune-up to keep your system running efficiently year-round.
long_description: Our maintenance visit includes filter replacement, coil cleaning, refrigerant level check, electrical connection tightening, thermostat calibration, and a full system performance report.
pricing_notes: Starting at $79 per visit. Maintenance plans with priority scheduling available.
ideal_for: Homeowners who want to prevent breakdowns, extend system life, and maintain manufacturer warranties.
benefits: Extends the lifespan of your HVAC system
Written system performance report after every visit

name: Duct Cleaning & Air Quality
short_description: Professional duct cleaning and indoor air quality solutions.
long_description: We remove dust, debris, allergens, and mold from your ductwork using commercial-grade equipment. We also install UV air purifiers, HEPA filtration systems, and whole-home humidifiers to improve indoor air quality.
pricing_notes: Duct cleaning starts at $299. Air quality add-ons priced separately.
ideal_for: Homeowners with allergies, pets, older ductwork, or concerns about dust and indoor air quality.
benefits: Removes allergens, dust mites, and mold spores
Reduces strain on your HVAC equipment
